basics.name: Romain Prignon
basics.label: Director of Engineering
basics.summary:
With more than 15 years in the web ecosystem, I have had the chance to grow with outstanding organizations.

Currently, I thrive on creating cross-team collaboration to deliver high-value products and meet product goals while improving Developer Experience (DevEx).
I am a 'builder-leader' who remains hands-on with technical functionality and production system improvements while scaling teams.

The ideal environment I like to contribute implies
- simplicity and excellence
- act consistently with empathy
- psychological safety, respect,and trust

highlights: Overseeing the technical strategy and organizational growth across 6 feature teams
Define software architecture (15 applications and databases in production)
Coordinate multiple feature teams to reach product goals
Help Improve feature teams best practices, tooling and methodologies
Directly managing 6 Tech Leads and overseeing an organization of 25 developers
Hiring process participation
Partner with the SRE/Infra team to manage infrastructure and the production platform
Identify and mitigate technology-related risks
Coordinate with Engineering managers and feature teams to design new applications
Define codebase architecture to improve code quality (ADR, diagram,...)
Developer Experience (15 developers)
Advise feature teams on best practices to improve efficiency and productivity
Optimize development process (performance, quality, ...)
Technical functionality development
Partner with the DevOps team to manage infrastructure and kubernetes clusters
Start an 'Infrastructure as code' culture within the company
Define and implement deployment process (ADR, CLI tools, automation)
Define the annual Developer Experience Roadmap for 25 developers
